Precise background-only edit of IMAGE 1. IMAGE 2 is only a reference for its neutral pale cool grey-blue seamless studio backdrop. Keep the product from IMAGE 1 absolutely identical: same shape, materials, cheap handmade assembly, scratches, tape, wires, LEDs or toast, framing and scale. Replace ONLY the entire background and supporting surface with a seamless neutral pale cool grey-blue studio sweep matching IMAGE 2, no horizon line or corner, no visible studio equipment, no softbox, no black diagonal object, no panels, no wall edges, no hard bands. Natural subtle grounded contact shadow under product. Soft 5200K camera-left diffuse light, 50mm f/8 photographic detail. Do not add the plant from image 2. No text, labels, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks. Product must remain shabby and homemade, not polished. Single product only.
resolution: 2k
